Charlie Kelly (It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia) | Charles "Charlie" Kelly is a fictional character and the main protagonist on the FX series "It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia", portrayed by Charlie Day.  Charlie is co-owner at Paddy's (although he later sells his shares) and a childhood friend of Mac and Dennis.
